name: Atlantic menhaden
description: Atlantic menhaden (Brevoortia tyrannus), tracked as its own compartment by the source. A schooling filter-feeding forage fish of the estuary, straining phytoplankton, zooplankton and suspended detritus; preyed on by bluefish, summer flounder and striped bass. Reported biomass (metrics.biomass) is the annual mean in mgC/m2.
